notes: share_pct = the broker's figure / the exchanges' combined MTF book (NSE closing book + BSE amount financed, mtf_daily.json) on the same date: the last reporting date on or before a period-end figure (within 7 days), or the month's average for a monthly average. Shares the brokers publish use their own denominators; these don't.
A row with measure 'share' is a share the filing states (ICICI Bank, Kotak Bank); its book_cr is derived (share x the exchanges' book) and marked derived.
chg / yoy compare a figure with the broker's previous figure (or the one about a year earlier) of the same measure and basis only.
From 1 Oct 2025 brokers report MTF to the exchanges on revised (gross) rules: NSE's book steps up 7 % that day, so changes across it compare different bases.
Figures come from each broker's or parent's own documents (url, page, quote); none from aggregators.

measures.share: a market share the filing states; the book is that share of the exchanges' book on the date
measures.gross: the gross MTF book, the basis the exchanges' book is on
measures.net: net of client cash collateral, or the balance-sheet loan line: usually 80-87 % of gross, so the share understates
measures.client_funding: MTF plus interest-bearing trade receivables (no MTF-only figure is published), so the share overstates
measures.unstated: the document calls it the MTF book without saying gross or net
